title: 23 Corbally Avenue, Citywest, Co. Dublin
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present No. 23 Corbally Avenue to the market – a stunning four-bedroom semi-detached family home, beautifully extended and ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Corbally development in Citywest, County Dublin.

Extending to approximately 117 sq.m, No. 23 offers bright, spacious and beautifully presented living accommodation throughout. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a cosy living room and a superb extended kitchen/dining/living area to the rear. This impressive open-plan space is flooded with natural light and provides the perfect setting for both everyday family living and entertaining. A separate utility room and guest W/C complete the ground floor.

Upstairs, there are three generous double bedrooms, including the master bedroom with ensuite, along with a main family bathroom. The attic has also been converted to provide a spacious fourth double bedroom.

To the rear is a sunny south-facing tiered garden, offering a private outdoor space with plenty of sunshine throughout the day and an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining.

Corbally is a highly sought-after development in the heart of Citywest, with a wide range of amenities close by. Citywest Village is just a short stroll away, while Citywest Shopping Centre, Dunnes Stores, cafés, restaurants, gyms and a choice of primary and secondary schools are all within easy reach.

The location is also excellent for commuters, with the Red Line Luas within walking distance, providing direct access to Dublin City Centre. The N7 and M50 are both easily accessible, while several Dublin Bus routes serve the surrounding area.

No. 23 Corbally Avenue is a gorgeous family home offering generous living space, a sunny south-facing garden and a superb location in one of Citywest’s most popular developments.

Early viewing is highly recommended – contact RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS today to arrange a viewing.
